microbiology: She is studying microbiology because she wants to learn how tiny living things affect our health.
她在学习微生物学，因为她想了解微小的生物是如何影响我们健康的。
carousel: We waited nearly an hour for our luggage to appear on the carousel.
我们等了将近一个小时，行李才出现在行李传送带上。
cameral: The new bill was debated in cameral sessions before it reached the full parliament.
这项新法案在提交全体议会之前，先在议院会议上进行了讨论。
flora: The island's unique flora attracts scientists from all over the world.
这座岛屿独特的植物群吸引了来自世界各地的科学家。
airtight: Store the cookies in an airtight container so they stay fresh.
把饼干存放在密闭的容器里，这样它们能保持新鲜。
subsoil: The workers dug through the soft topsoil and reached the hard subsoil below.
工人们挖开松软的表土，碰到了下面坚硬的底层土。
fact sheet: The hotel gave us a fact sheet listing all the services it offers.
酒店给了我们一份资料摘要，列出了它提供的所有服务。
opulence: Visitors are often amazed by the opulence of the palace's gold decorated rooms.
游客们常常对宫殿里金碧辉煌的房间的奢华感到惊叹。
darkroom: My grandfather developed his photographs in a darkroom behind the house.
我祖父在屋后的一间暗室里冲洗他的照片。
detergent: This detergent removes tough stains without damaging your clothes.
这种清洁剂能去除顽固污渍，而且不会损坏衣物。
terrestrial: Unlike fish, terrestrial animals must breathe air to survive.
与鱼类不同，陆生动物必须呼吸空气才能生存。
familiarise: Please familiarise yourself with the safety rules before entering the lab.
进入实验室之前，请先熟悉一下安全规则。
caustic: Be careful with that caustic substance, because it can burn your skin.
小心那种腐蚀性物质，它会灼伤你的皮肤。
ancestral: The family returned to their ancestral village to attend the festival.
这家人回到祖传的村庄参加节日庆典。
arboreal: Monkeys are arboreal creatures that spend most of their lives in trees.
猴子是树栖动物，它们一生中大部分时间都在树上度过。
optometrist: The optometrist tested my eyes and told me I needed new glasses.
验光师检查了我的眼睛，告诉我需要配一副新眼镜。
disempower: Managers should encourage their teams rather than disempower them with constant criticism.
管理者应该鼓励团队，而不是用不断的批评去削弱他们的影响力。
suppression: The suppression of free speech caused widespread anger among the students.
对言论自由的压制在学生中引起了广泛的愤怒。
pumice: Pumice is so light that this volcanic rock can float on water.
浮石非常轻，这种火山岩能浮在水面上。
cinematography: The film won an award for its beautiful cinematography and stunning camera work.
这部电影因其精美的电影摄影和出色的镜头运用而获奖。
crushing: The team suffered a crushing defeat in the final game of the season.
该队在赛季最后一场比赛中惨遭毁灭性失败。
revegetate: The mining company promised to revegetate the damaged land within five years.
矿业公司承诺在五年内让受损的土地重新长出植被。
herbal: My grandmother prefers herbal tea to coffee before going to bed.
我祖母睡前宁愿喝花草茶也不喝咖啡。
underling: The manager treated every underling with respect, no matter how small their job was.
这位经理对每个下属都很尊重，无论他们的工作多么微不足道。
Kung Fu: He practises Kung Fu every morning to keep his body strong and his mind calm.
他每天早上练功夫，以保持身体强壮、心态平和。
fertilise: Farmers fertilise their fields in spring to help the crops grow well.
农民在春天给田地施肥，帮助庄稼长得好。
deviance: Sociologists study deviance to understand why some people break social rules.
社会学家研究越轨行为，以了解为什么有些人会违反社会规则。
autoimmune: In autoimmune diseases, the body's own defences attack its healthy cells by mistake.
在自身免疫疾病中，身体自身的防御系统会错误地攻击健康细胞。
pretentious: He sounded pretentious when he used long French words just to impress us.
他为了给我们留下深刻印象而故意使用长长的法语词，听起来很自负。
truant: The teacher called the boy's parents because he often played truant from school.
老师给那个男孩的父母打了电话，因为他经常逃课。
sophisticate: As a city sophisticate, she found country life quiet but a little boring at first.
作为一个久经世故的城市人，她起初觉得乡村生活安静却有点无聊。
curry: This chicken curry is a little spicy, but it tastes wonderful with rice.
这道咖喱鸡有点辣，但配米饭吃味道非常好。
synchronise: The dancers practised for weeks to synchronise their movements perfectly.
舞者们练习了数周，以便让他们的动作完全同步。
cultivation: The cultivation of rice in this region goes back more than a thousand years.
该地区种植水稻的历史可以追溯到一千多年前。
mandarin: She peeled a mandarin and shared the juicy segments with her little brother.
她剥了一个橘子，把多汁的橘瓣分给了弟弟。
precipitation: The desert receives very little precipitation, sometimes none for a whole year.
沙漠里降水极少，有时整整一年都没有降雨。
tick off: Remember to tick off each name on the list as the guests arrive.
客人到达时，记得把名单上的每个名字勾出来。
for the sake of: He gave up smoking for the sake of his health and his family.
为了自己和家人的健康，他戒了烟。
in accordance with: Employees must wear safety helmets in accordance with the factory's rules.
按照工厂的规定，员工必须佩戴安全头盔。
bump into: I often bump into my neighbors when I walk the dog in the park.
我在公园遛狗时经常碰到我的邻居们。
